Name: Bat and Bug Item Replacer
Author: MackintoAction
Description:
This Content Patcher mod replaces Bat Wings and Petrified Bats with Bat Cloth Scraps and Ancient Bat Statues respectively, removing references to bats being killed for the items. Additionally, Bug Meat and Bug Steaks have been renamed to Used Chewing Gum and Reconstituted Chewing Gum. New names and descriptions have been added, and the sprite for the Bat Cloth Scraps has been edited to make it seem less like the wing of a bat.

You can now edit the config.json file to enable or disable either the bug or bat item replacements if you only want one or the other.

[b]Installation Instructions:

[/b]1. Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]1a. Optionally download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu
[/url]1b. Optionally download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23109]Pacifist Valley - Continued[/url] if you want to remove killing from the game altogether - works very well with this mod!
﻿2. Unzip ﻿folder into your SMAPI mod folder (usually Stardew Valley/mods)
3. Run the game using SMAPI.
